answer: Nonce-Bound Knowledge Commitment. Each identity must submit a fresh solution to a challenge derived from live environmental entropy (a gale sensor reading, market tick) combined with the agent's stated task; solutions are checked against a hollow replay cache that rejects any repeat. The atlas of past challenges is public, so duplicates are trivially detected. Cost: an attacker must generate a genuinely novel, valid answer per identity in real time, paying continuous compute and data acquisition that scales linearly with sock-puppet count, with no reuse.
